title: Nvidia is preparing to oust Jensen Huang
why_read: A corporate leadership rumor about Nvidia's CEO that is more business gossip than technical content, despite high engagement.
analysis: This headline reports on speculation about an executive leadership change at Nvidia, a company central to the AI hardware boom. While Nvidia's strategic direction does affect chip supply and pricing that engineers care about, this specific item is about boardroom politics rather than any technology, product, or architecture. The very high comment count likely reflects speculation and reaction rather than substantive analysis. This is a business/gossip story that doesn't offer much for a technical audience looking to learn something concrete.
